summary: M39z.d District Consolidator · Backend + Frontend verified. Wrote 14 pytest cases in test_m39zd_district_consolidator.py — 12 PASS, 2 SKIPPED (skipped because the persistent seed tournament bb71efd9 already had this District's claim past-Draft from main-agent smoke-test; fresh-claim MPCA-override test also skipped by design once 409-idempotency existed). All critical route/authority/consolidation invariants verified: District submit auto-routes to parent Division (route_to_body_id=DIV-IND, review_stage=Division, chain notes 'Routed to DIV-IND'); wrong Division (DIV-BPL) blocked with 403 on both approve AND reject; correct Division (DIV-IND) approves; consolidate creates is_master=true claim with child_claim_ids populated, sets parent_claim_id on children, is idempotent (second call with no new approved children returns 409 with clear message), returns 422 for non-Division target, returns 403 for wrong Division; MPCA (X-Body-Type: State) override works; preview endpoint returns approved-not-consolidated children + roll_up_total_inr + own_claim_id; list_claims filters (route_to_body_id, is_master, exclude_consolidated) all correctly scoped. Tournament GET now allows District via parent Division participation verified. Frontend verified via Playwright + screenshots: District persona → no fc-tab-pipeline (correct), claims-panel loads with contextual copy 'goes to your Division for review, then rolls up to MPCA as part of the Division master' (exact match), District's already-consolidated claim shows MASTER/ROLLED UP/SANCTIONED pills. Division persona → claims-panel loads, master row shows 'MASTER' pill + '+ 1 District claim inside' hint + 'Submit to MPCA' button + Upload signed PDF action. MPCA persona → claims-panel with MASTER pills visible. district-review-panel and claims-consolidate-btn correctly hidden because the only child under DIV-IND is already Approved AND consolidated (parent_claim_id set) — empty-state behavior matches spec. No regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: reimbursement_claims.py submit_claim (line ~337-360) — clean routing logic: District → parent_code (422 if missing), else → MPCA. Notification recipient_role also switches (district-secretary vs division-secretary) which is correct.
approve_claim + reject_claim guard (line ~464-475, 524-533) — DRY-ish but nearly duplicated 12-line block; consider extracting `_ensure_route_authority(doc, scope)` helper.
consolidate endpoint idempotency uses status ∈ {Draft, Rejected} lookup to reuse master (line ~655-660). Safe.

consolidate creates master with `notes` mentioning child_docs count but master is upserted — on second successful consolidate the notes will still say original count. Minor cosmetic issue — heads/summary is recomputed correctly.

list_claims 'exclude_consolidated' filter uses `parent_claim_id: None` which correctly matches missing/null but may not match empty-string values if any legacy docs have that shape. Acceptable given the model default is None.
TournamentFinanceConsole.jsx now 1420 lines — still growing past 700-line rule. Consider splitting ClaimsPanel, DivisionBudgetCard, MatrixRow into /pages/finance/*.jsx.
ClaimsPanel `submitTargetLabel` derivation happens per-row; label logic (line ~1382) — good UX detail.

No end-to-end integration test in pytest that exercises the FULL D→submit→Div approve→consolidate→master submit→MPCA approve chain in one run against a fresh tournament. Consider adding when a disposable-tournament fixture exists.
